inputs.prompt: Edit <image1> into a photorealistic standardized front-facing chest-up portrait of exactly the same person. Preserve the person's identity, facial proportions, skin tone, hairstyle, eyewear and jewelry when present, and the original clothing design and main colors. Remove hands and foreground obstructions from the face and frame. The head and gaze face straight toward the camera, both eyes clearly visible, shoulders level, neutral relaxed expression, lips softly closed. Center the head and shoulders with 15 percent safe margin above the hair. Replace the entire background with one uniform warm light-gray matte studio wall, exact visual color #D8D3CC, soft diffuse frontal studio lighting, no furniture, no objects, no decorations, no texture, no text, no hard shadow. Realistic photography, natural skin texture, 2:3 vertical composition.
